chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Abu Basir, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام saying:
They ask you about the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is from the command of my Lord.
He عليه السلام said: It is a creation greater than Jibra'il and Mika'il. It was not with anyone who passed before except Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله, and it is with the Imams, guiding them rightly.
And not everything that is sought is found.

key_terms.أَمْرِ: command, indicating divine origin and authority
key_terms.الرُّوحِ: the Spirit, described here as a special creation from the command of Allah
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams, with whom this Spirit remains
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلَ: Jibra'il, the archangel, used here as a point of comparison
key_terms.مِيكَائِيلَ: Mika'il, the archangel, also used as a point of comparison

ai.seo_question: What does the verse "They ask you about the Spirit" mean according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Quranic mention of the Spirit as a distinct creation from the command of Allah, greater than Jibra'il and Mika'il. It states that this Spirit was with Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله and remains with the Imams, supporting and directing them. The report highlights a special divine aid connected to Imamate and the unseen.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Abu Baseer who said,
[17:85] And they are asking you about the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is from the Commands of my Lord.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A creature more magnificent than Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> and Mikaeel<sup>as</sup>. It did not happen to be with anyone from the past apart from Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and it is with the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, protecting them<sup>asws</sup>
, and it isn’t so that everything what is sought, it found’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from abu Basir who has said the following. “I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘“They ask you about the Spirit. Say, “The Spirit comes by the command of my Lord. . .” [17:85]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “He is a creature greater than Jibril and Mika’il. He was present with anyone before except Muhammad (s.a.). He is present with the Imams (a.s.). He protects them. It is not that whatever is desired is found.”
